description: A voltage controlled envelope generator with a stereo VCA, with a gate output for each stage and timing curves modelled on the CEM3310

params.text: Selects the shape: ADSR, AD with no sustain and both falling stages timed by DECAY, or AR with a full sustain and both falling stages timed by RELEASE
When on, a trigger at TRIG restarts the attack from the level the envelope has reached
When on, the envelope is driven quickly to zero before each attack stage
When on, the envelope retriggers itself whenever it completes, and runs without a gate
Sets the attack time, 1.2ms to 80 seconds
Attenuates the attack CV input, 0 to 1
Sets the decay time, 1.2ms to 80 seconds
Attenuates the decay CV input, 0 to 1
Sets the level held while the gate stays high, 0 to 1
Attenuates the sustain CV input, 0 to 1
Sets the release time, 1.2ms to 80 seconds
Attenuates the release CV input, 0 to 1

inputs.text: Modulates the attack time through its attenuator, 10V covering the whole range
Modulates the decay time through its attenuator, 10V covering the whole range
Modulates the sustain level through its attenuator, 10V covering the whole range
Modulates the release time through its attenuator, 10V covering the whole range
The left audio into the VCA
The right audio into the VCA
A rising edge restarts the attack when RETRIG is on
A high gate runs the envelope through attack, decay and sustain, and a low gate starts the release; its channel count sets the polyphony

outputs.text: 10V for as long as the envelope is in its attack stage
10V for as long as the envelope is in its decay stage
10V for as long as the envelope is in its sustain stage
10V for as long as the envelope is in its release stage
The left input multiplied by the envelope
The right input multiplied by the envelope
10V for the moment the envelope finishes its cycle

menu: Waveshaping — runs the VCA outputs through a curve sampled from a hardware VCA, a different curve on the left and the right
